capabilities: chat with Claude Code in a streaming right-sidebar panel
auto-mention the active note, folder, selection, or picked files in prompts
choose tool approval modes and confirm or auto-run Claude Code actions
view Claude plan, organization, and rate-limit consumption
extras: Desktop only (no mobile). The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Japanese documentation is in README.ja.md; BRAT can be used for sideloading or pre-release builds.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to let an AI agent read, write, search, and run commands against notes directly from inside the app.

relations.evidence: spawns the claude CLI as a subprocess with the active vault as its working directory

requires.name: claude CLI (plus Node.js, Git, PowerShell 7 on Windows)
Claude Pro / Max subscription or Anthropic API key

summary: Right-sidebar chat panel that runs the Claude Code CLI as a subprocess with the active vault as its working directory.
